            rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None

action(['RIGHT'])
print("piece after RIGHT:",piece_pos(current_frame))

def piece_pos(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O' and 60<n['pixels']<120:

            rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
